title: Navan Edge vs. AwardWallet: Which is right for you?
summary: Compare Navan Edge and AwardWallet for booking work trips, tracking loyalty balances, finding award flights, and handling travel support.
body_markdown:
AwardWallet helps travelers keep track of loyalty accounts, balances, expiration dates, and itineraries. It also offers a request-based service for finding award flights. Navan Edge allows individuals to plan and book business trips, including flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations, with loyalty programs incorporated into travel recommendations.


If you're comparing the two, the key question is whether you need help managing rewards, booking travel, or both. Here's how their capabilities differ and when each might be useful.


### Key takeaways


- AwardWallet tracks loyalty balances, expiration dates, and travel plans across supported programs.
- Navan Edge brings connected loyalty information together while allowing travelers to plan and book business flights, hotels and restaurants.
- AwardWallet offers a separately priced award-flight booking service, while Navan Edge provides 24/7 travel support for trips booked through its conversational experience.
- Qualifying Navan Edge bookings can earn loyalty points and air miles, applicable credit card rewards, and up to 10% back in Amazon Gift Cards on eligible hotel stays.


## What’s the verdict on Navan Edge vs. AwardWallet?


AwardWallet offers dedicated tools for tracking loyalty balances, expiration dates, and travel plans across multiple programs. It also provides a separately priced service to help travelers find award flights.3,4


Navan Edge is a better fit for travelers who want to manage their loyalty information while planning and booking work trips. It’s a dedicated AI travel agent with a Loyalty Wallet that brings connected program details together, and can recommend options that factor in your connected loyalty programs. Travelers can search and book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations through a single conversation, with 24/7 travel support available in the same thread.1

## How does each assistant handle a real work trip?


Say you're traveling to San Francisco for a conference and need a flight, a hotel near the venue, and dinner with a colleague.


With Navan Edge, you can share those details in a conversation, review flight and hotel recommendations, and arrange dinner reservations. Your connected loyalty programs can inform the recommendations, and you confirm your selections before booking.


AwardWallet can help you check your loyalty balances before deciding whether to use miles for the flight. If you want assistance finding an award flight, you can submit a request to its booking team.3


## How do Navan Edge and AwardWallet handle loyalty and rewards?


AwardWallet is designed for travelers who manage several loyalty accounts and want to keep track of the rewards they've earned. It can help you monitor balances and expiration dates, with additional features such as elite-status information available through AwardWallet Plus.3\[5 AwardWallet also offers a separate business interface for companies managing travelers’ loyalty accounts


Navan Edge's Loyalty Wallet also brings connected loyalty information together in one place so you can consider your preferred programs when booking flights and hotels. On qualifying bookings, Navan Edge travelers may receive three types of benefits:


- **Hotel loyalty points or miles** when the booking qualifies under the hotel's loyalty program.
- **Credit card rewards or multipliers** associated with the payment card used.
- Up to 10% back in Amazon Gift Cards on qualifying hotel stays booked through Navan Edge, following the completed stay.


## What support do Navan Edge and AwardWallet provide?


Navan Edge offers 24/7 travel support through the same in-app conversation used to plan and book trips. Travelers get AI assistance and can request a human travel expert at any time, who joins the same conversation with the trip details and context already available.


AwardWallet provides account support separately from its award-flight booking service. For award-flight requests, travelers work with a booking team that works with AwardWallet to research and arrange an itinerary. Award-booking questions are handled by that booking team, while other questions can be submitedd through AwardWallet’s Contact Us page.3,6


## Should you choose Navan Edge or AwardWallet for business travel?


AwardWallet is worth considering if you mainly want to monitor loyalty accounts across multiple programs or get specialized help finding an award flight.


If you're planning a full work trip, Navan Edge considers your loyalty programs as you search and book flights and hotels, and can help surface results based on your specific preferences from an aisle seat to a hotel with a gym. dyson hairdryer in the hotel bathroom. You can also arrange restaurant reservations, and have access to 24/7 travel support without switching to a separate booking service.
